Matcha Smoothie
By: Simmer + Sauce
Published: Monday, January 1, 2018 - 3:21pm

Ingredients




1/2 banana
1 (6-ounce) vanilla low-fat skyr yogurt
1 teaspoon matcha powder
1 1/2 tablespoons almond butter
1 date, pitted
1/2 cup almond milk
1 cup ice

Preparation

1 Using a kitchen blender, add the banana, yogurt, matcha powder, almond butter, date, almond milk and ice. Blend on high for 1 minute. 2 Serve immediately.

About

Start your New Year off right with this protein packed matcha smoothie, it's just what you need after an over-indulgent holiday season.
